The '''Golan I Space Defense Platform''', also known as the '''Golan Space Defense SpaceGun''', was the first space station in [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]' series of [[Golan space defense platform|space defense platforms]].

==Description==
The Golan I was armed with 28 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], 5 [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers, and 6 [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors, and had a small hangar bay capable of launching 24 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

==History==
First built during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Golan I was used to defend small planetary outposts and space facilities such as shipyards.

Although they were eventually succeeded by the [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun]], the Golan I remained deadly to starfighters and small capital ships through the end of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
